market_context: At 10:21 AM, markets opened lower with tech-heavy Nasdaq hit hard by Alphabet's Q3 sales miss and renewed AI concerns. The S&P 500 and Dow were mildly negative, while small caps rallied on rotation. Strong Q3 GDP (3.4%) and sticky PCE inflation (3.6% YoY) reinforced rate-pause expectations but stoked caution. Amazon earnings after the close may keep pressure on tech.

predictions.reasoning: Alphabet's sales miss and AI jitters sparked a 1.57% drop in QQQ by mid-morning, per [marketsignal-daily.com. Semiconductor and software names are under pressure, and with Amazon earnings looming after the close, tech weakness is likely to persist into the close.

SPY was -0.51% at 10:10 AM according to finance.yahoo.com, dragged by tech but offset by defensive sectors. Sticky inflation data and dissenting Fed hawks cap upside, so a mild further decline is probable.

The Dow was nearly flat at 10:13 AM, according to finance.yahoo.com, and small-cap strength suggests rotation out of tech could benefit cyclicals. DIA may edge slightly higher as traders reposition ahead of Amazon earnings.

IWM was +0.99% at 9:52 AM, per marketsignal-daily.com, as investors rotated from overpriced AI megacaps into small-cap value. With no major negative catalysts for small caps, the trend likely continues through the close.

Crypto typically suffers when tech sentiment sours, as seen in the Nasdaq sell-off. BTC-USD was down 0.6% over five days prior to today, and risk-off mood from AI jitters and hawkish Fed commentary could extend the decline.
